title: Building agents with Skills: Equipping agents for specialized work
tldr: Introduces a framework for building specialized AI agents by equipping them with distinct skills, enabling them to perform complex tasks by breaking them down into manageable sub-problems. This approach enhances agent autonomy and capability in diverse real-world applications.

title: Extending Claude’s capabilities with skills and MCP servers
tldr: Details the technical architecture for extending Claude's capabilities, integrating specialized skills via Multi-Component Protocol (MCP) servers. This enables more complex, modular agentic behaviors and scalable resource utilization.

title: Making Claude a better electrical engineer
tldr: Discusses methods and evaluations used to enhance Claude's proficiency in electrical engineering, focusing on techniques for specialized knowledge integration and reasoning in complex technical domains. This demonstrates successful domain adaptation for large language models.

title: Scaling content review operations with multi-agent workflow
tldr: Describes an architecture for scaling content review operations through a multi-agent workflow, optimizing efficiency and accuracy. This leverages distributed AI agents to automate and enhance complex moderation tasks.

title: Introducing NVIDIA Cosmos Policy for Advanced Robot Control
tldr: NVIDIA unveils Cosmos Policy, a new framework designed for advanced robot control, enabling more sophisticated and adaptive autonomous behaviors. This policy-based approach aims to enhance robotic manipulation and decision-making in complex environments.

title: Project Genie: Experimenting with infinite, interactive worlds
tldr: DeepMind unveils Project Genie, an experimental platform for generating infinite, interactive virtual worlds using advanced AI models. This research explores novel methods for procedural content generation and dynamic environment interaction.

title: Inside OpenAI’s in-house data agent
tldr: OpenAI published insights into its internally developed data agent, highlighting its architecture for automating data retrieval, analysis, and report generation across various internal teams. This system significantly enhances operational efficiency by enabling rapid access to structured and unstructured data through natural language queries.

title: Retiring GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and OpenAI o4-mini in ChatGPT
tldr: OpenAI announced the deprecation of several previous generation models, including GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, and GPT-4.1 mini, from their ChatGPT platform. This strategic move indicates a focus on newer, more advanced models, necessitating developers to update their integrations to maintain compatibility and leverage the latest AI capabilities.

title: Introducing Daggr: Chain apps programmatically, inspect visually
tldr: Hugging Face introduces Daggr, a new tool for programmatically chaining applications and visually inspecting their workflows. It provides a robust framework for orchestrating complex AI pipelines and debugging agentic systems.

title: Ensuring Balanced GPU Allocation in Kubernetes Clusters with Time-Based Fairshare
tldr: Introduces a time-based fairshare mechanism for ensuring balanced GPU allocation within Kubernetes clusters, optimizing resource utilization for AI/ML workloads. This enhances fairness and efficiency in shared compute environments.

title: Speeding Up Variable-Length Training with Dynamic Context Parallelism and NVIDIA Megatron Core
tldr: Details advanced techniques for accelerating variable-length model training by implementing dynamic context parallelism within NVIDIA Megatron Core. This significantly improves efficiency and throughput for large language model development.

title: Updating Classifier Evasion for Vision Language Models
tldr: Presents updated research on classifier evasion techniques specifically targeting Vision Language Models, analyzing new vulnerabilities and potential mitigation strategies. This work contributes to enhancing the robustness and security of multimodal AI systems.

title: Context Management for Deep Agents
tldr: Explores advanced strategies for context management within deep agent architectures, focusing on optimizing memory and reasoning capabilities over extended interactions. This addresses critical challenges in developing robust and scalable autonomous AI systems.

title: Keeping your data safe when an AI agent clicks a link
tldr: OpenAI detailed its approach to ensuring data safety when AI agents interact with external links, focusing on robust security protocols. This includes employing sophisticated sandboxing, dynamic content analysis, and strict access controls to prevent malicious exploits or unintended data exposure during agent-driven web activity.

title: We Got Claude to Build CUDA Kernels and teach open models!
tldr: This article details an experiment where Claude was successfully prompted to generate optimized CUDA kernels and subsequently used to instruct other open-source models. This showcases advanced agentic capabilities for code generation and knowledge transfer in AI systems.

title: Accelerating Diffusion Models with an Open, Plug-and-Play Offering
tldr: Introduces an open, plug-and-play offering designed to significantly accelerate the inference and training of diffusion models. This initiative provides developers with optimized components to integrate powerful generative AI capabilities more efficiently.

title: UniRG: Scaling medical imaging report generation with multimodal reinforcement learning
tldr: Microsoft Research introduces UniRG, a novel framework leveraging multimodal reinforcement learning to scale the generation of medical imaging reports. This system integrates visual and textual data to produce accurate and contextually relevant diagnostic summaries.

title: Architectural Choices in China's Open-Source AI Ecosystem: Building Beyond DeepSeek
tldr: This analysis delves into the architectural decisions shaping China's open-source AI ecosystem, examining trends and innovations beyond foundational models like DeepSeek. It provides insights into the evolution of model designs and development paradigms in the region.

title: Alyah ⭐️: Toward Robust Evaluation of Emirati Dialect Capabilities in Arabic LLMs
tldr: Introduces Alyah, a new benchmark and methodology for robustly evaluating the capabilities of Arabic Large Language Models specifically in understanding and generating the Emirati dialect. This work addresses critical gaps in cross-dialectal LLM performance assessment.

title: Unlocking Agentic RL Training for GPT-OSS: A Practical Retrospective
tldr: This retrospective details practical methodologies and challenges encountered while implementing agentic reinforcement learning training for open-source GPT models. It offers key insights into improving the efficiency and effectiveness of RL-driven agent development.

title: Introducing Prism
tldr: OpenAI unveiled "Prism," a new advanced AI system or platform, signifying a major expansion of their technological offerings. While specific details are forthcoming, this introduction suggests new capabilities in a frontier area of AI research or a significant improvement in existing model paradigms.

title: Adaptive Inference in NVIDIA TensorRT for RTX Enables Automatic Optimization
tldr: Highlights the new adaptive inference capabilities within NVIDIA TensorRT for RTX, which automatically optimizes model execution for improved performance. This allows for dynamic adjustments during inference, enhancing efficiency across various hardware configurations.

title: Build a serverless AI Gateway architecture with AWS AppSync Events
tldr: Presents a serverless AI Gateway architecture using AWS AppSync Events, designed to manage and orchestrate AI service invocations efficiently. This approach enables scalable and decoupled integration of AI capabilities into modern applications.

title: How to Unlock Local Detail in Coarse Climate Projections with NVIDIA Earth-2
tldr: Describes methods for super-resolving coarse climate projections to reveal local details using NVIDIA Earth-2, leveraging advanced AI models for high-fidelity environmental simulations. This enables more granular and accurate climate impact assessments.
